rule_sets.name: QS Gate Rules
rule_sets.description: Data-driven QS pedestrian gate BOM rules v1

rule_versions.notes: Initial QS gate rules — screw-fixed 65mm blades, HD rail, QSG side frames

product_constraints.name: slat_size_enum
product_constraints.message: QS gate supports 65mm slat size only

product_variables.name: slat_size_mm
product_variables.label: Slat Size
product_variables.notes: Swing gates are validated to 65mm. Sliding gate rules support 65mm and 90mm slats.

product_validations.name: gate_width_in_range
product_validations.expression: (equalText(gate_movement, "sliding") and gate_width_mm >= 800 and gate_width_mm <= 6000) or (not equalText(gate_movement, "sliding") and gate_width_mm >= 400 and gate_width_mm <= 1200)
product_validations.message: Swing gates must be 400-1200mm wide. Sliding gates must be 800-6000mm wide.

product_validations.name: gate_height_in_range
product_validations.message: Gate height must be between 600mm and 2100mm

product_validations.name: lock_box_type_required_if_enabled
product_validations.message: A lock box type must be selected when lock box is enabled

product_validations.name: swing_gate_65mm_only
product_validations.message: Swing gates must use 65mm slats. Select a sliding gate to use 90mm slats.

product_validations.name: qsg_gate_supported_gap
product_validations.message: QSG gates currently support 5mm, 9mm or 20mm spacer gaps.

product_rules.name: is_sliding
product_rules.notes: Numeric flag used by selector and companion predicates.

product_rules.name: is_swing
product_rules.notes: Numeric flag used to keep swing-only hardware off sliding gates.

product_rules.name: is_vertical_gate
product_rules.notes: True when the gate is built with vertical slats.

product_rules.name: gate_blade_cut_mm
product_rules.notes: Swing gate blade cut = gate_width - 86mm.

product_rules.name: rail65_cut_mm
product_rules.notes: Swing gate top/bottom rail cut = gate_width - 80mm.

product_rules.name: gsf_cut_mm
product_rules.notes: Swing gate side frame cut = gate_height - 3mm.

product_rules.name: num_gate_blades
product_rules.notes: Gate blade count: 133mm top+bottom rail allowance (vs 3mm lip in fence). Reverse formula from fence with 133mm deduction instead of 3mm.

product_rules.name: sliding_blade_cut_mm
product_rules.notes: Sliding blade cut. Vertical gates cut slats to height; horizontal gates cut slats to opening width.

product_rules.name: sliding_rail_cut_mm
product_rules.notes: Sliding top and bottom rail cut = gate width - 80mm.

product_rules.name: sliding_frame_cut_mm
product_rules.notes: Sliding side-frame cut = gate height - 31mm.

product_rules.name: sliding_design_slat_size
product_rules.notes: Normalises the selected sliding slat size.

product_rules.name: sliding_num_gate_blades
product_rules.expression: is_sliding ? max(1, is_vertical_gate ? floor((gate_width_mm - 89 + slat_gap_mm) / (sliding_design_slat_size + slat_gap_mm)) : floor((gate_height_mm - slat_gap_mm - 216) / (sliding_design_slat_size + slat_gap_mm))) : 0
product_rules.notes: Sliding gate blade count from QSG workbook formulas.

product_rules.name: sliding_infill_stock_length_mm
product_rules.notes: Vertical sliding gates use channel infill; horizontal uses QSG infill.

product_rules.name: sliding_infill_cut_mm
product_rules.notes: Sliding gate infill cut length.

product_rules.name: sliding_track_stock_mm
product_rules.notes: Selected track stock length.

product_rules.name: sliding_track_is_steel
product_rules.notes: Steel track requires anchor pins; aluminium track does not.

product_rules.name: sliding_track_anchor_per_length
product_rules.notes: Anchor pins per steel track length.

product_rules.name: sliding_csr_required
product_rules.notes: Centre support rail is required for sliding gates over 3000mm.

product_rules.name: sliding_csr_cut_mm
product_rules.notes: Sliding centre support rail cut length.

product_rules.name: sliding_motor_enabled
product_rules.notes: Automation or explicit motor selection flag.

product_rules.name: blades_per_stock_length
product_rules.notes: How many blade cuts from one 6100mm stock length

product_rules.name: blade_stock_lengths_needed
product_rules.notes: Stock lengths of gate blade needed

product_rules.name: rails_per_stock_length
product_rules.notes: How many 65mm QSG rail cuts from one 4800mm stock length

product_rules.name: rail_stock_lengths_needed
product_rules.notes: 2 65mm QSG rails needed per gate (top + bottom)

product_rules.name: sliding_blade_stocks
product_rules.notes: 6100mm slat stock lengths for sliding gate blades.

product_rules.name: sliding_rail_stocks
product_rules.notes: 6100mm stock length count per sliding gate rail.

product_rules.name: sliding_gsf_stocks
product_rules.notes: 4200mm QSG side-frame stock lengths.

product_rules.name: sliding_cover_stocks
product_rules.notes: 4200mm screw-cover stock lengths.

product_rules.name: sliding_infill_stocks
product_rules.notes: QSG sliding infill stock lengths.

product_rules.name: sliding_csr_stocks
product_rules.notes: 5800mm centre support rail stock lengths.

product_rules.name: sliding_track_qty
product_rules.notes: Sliding track quantity uses double the opening width.

product_rules.name: rail_screw_packs_needed
product_rules.notes: Rail screws for 65mm QSG top + bottom rails, sold in 50-packs

product_rules.name: slat_spacer_packs_needed
product_rules.notes: Slat spacers for pedestrian gate slats, sold in 50-packs

product_rules.name: wafer_screw_packs_needed
product_rules.notes: Wafer screws for pedestrian gate slats, sold in 50-packs

product_rules.name: gsf_screw_count_per_frame
product_rules.notes: F-section screws per GSF: MAX(3, ROUNDUP((gsf_cut - 40)/600, 0) + 1)

product_rules.name: gsf_total_screws
product_rules.notes: 2 GSF per gate × 2 sides each = total GSF screws

product_rules.name: sliding_track_anchor_qty
product_rules.notes: Track anchor pins for steel track.

product_rules.name: sliding_spacer_packs_needed
product_rules.notes: Spacer packs for sliding gate slat gaps.

product_rules.name: sliding_wafer_screw_packs_needed
product_rules.notes: Wafer screw packs for sliding gate slats.

product_rules.name: sliding_rail_screw_packs_needed
product_rules.notes: One rail screw pack for sliding top and bottom rails.

product_rules.name: emit_gate_blades
product_rules.notes: Emit gate blade stock lengths (resolved via gate_blade_65_selector)

product_rules.name: emit_rail65
product_rules.notes: Emit 65mm QSG rail stock lengths — 1 per gate typically (2 cuts per 4800mm stock)

product_rules.name: emit_gate_stop
product_rules.notes: 3 gate stops per gate: 2 latch side + 1 hinge side (4200mm stock each)

product_rules.name: emit_hinge_latch_combo
product_rules.notes: Disabled: hinge quantity is emitted by gate_add_hinge_latch companion as exactly 2 hinges per leaf.

product_rules.name: emit_lock_box
product_rules.notes: 1 lock box if include_lock_box is true — SKU resolved via lock_box_selector

product_rules.name: emit_gate_side_frames
product_rules.notes: 2 QSG gate side frames per gate — GSF pricing TBD

product_rules.name: emit_gate_infill
product_rules.notes: QSG gate infill for top and bottom 65mm rail runs

product_rules.name: emit_joiner_blocks
product_rules.notes: 1 pack of joiner blocks per gate — size matches slat_size_mm (only 65 currently)

product_rules.name: emit_screw_covers
product_rules.notes: 1 screw cover length per gate

product_rules.name: emit_frame_top_caps
product_rules.notes: 4 gate frame top caps per gate (2 per GSF × 2 GSF)

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_gate_blades
product_rules.notes: Emit sliding gate slat stock lengths.

product_rules.notes: Emit sliding gate top rail stock lengths.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_bottom_rail
product_rules.notes: Emit sliding gate bottom rail stock lengths.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_side_frames
product_rules.notes: Emit QSG sliding side-frame stock lengths.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_screw_covers
product_rules.notes: Emit QSG screw-cover stock lengths.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_infill
product_rules.notes: Emit QSG infill stock lengths.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_joiner_blocks
product_rules.notes: Emit sliding rail joiner block pack.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_frame_top_caps
product_rules.notes: Two top caps for the sliding gate side frames.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_csr
product_rules.notes: Emit centre support rail when required.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_csrc
product_rules.notes: Emit centre support rail cap when required.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_csr_plates
product_rules.notes: Emit top and bottom CSR plates when required.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_track
product_rules.notes: Emit selected sliding track lengths.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_track_anchors
product_rules.notes: Emit steel track anchor pins.

product_rules.notes: Emit sliding gate wheels.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_wheel_clamps
product_rules.notes: Emit wheel clamping set.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_guide
product_rules.notes: Emit selected sliding guide.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_stop
product_rules.notes: Emit bolt-down gate stop.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_catch
product_rules.notes: Emit selected sliding catch.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_motor_400
product_rules.expression: is_sliding ? ((automation_enabled == true and equalText(automation_power_source, "mains") and automation_cable_distance_m <= 30) or equalText(sliding_motor_type, "XPSG-FILO-400") ? 1 : 0) : 0
product_rules.notes: Emit Filo 400 motor kit for normal mains automation or explicit selection.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_motor_400_split
product_rules.expression: is_sliding ? ((automation_enabled == true and equalText(automation_power_source, "mains") and automation_cable_distance_m > 30) or equalText(sliding_motor_type, "XPSG-FILO-400PRO-SP") ? 1 : 0) : 0
product_rules.notes: Emit split-pack Filo kit for long cable distance or explicit selection.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_solar_kit
product_rules.expression: is_sliding and automation_enabled == true and equalText(automation_power_source, "solar") ? 1 : 0
product_rules.notes: Emit solar power kit.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_battery
product_rules.expression: is_sliding and automation_enabled == true and automation_battery == true ? 1 : 0
product_rules.notes: Emit backup battery.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_keypad
product_rules.expression: is_sliding and automation_enabled == true and automation_keypad == true ? 1 : 0
product_rules.notes: Emit wireless keypad.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_extra_remotes
product_rules.expression: is_sliding and automation_enabled == true ? min(10, max(0, automation_extra_remotes)) : 0
product_rules.notes: Emit selected extra remotes.

product_rules.name: emit_sliding_motor_rack
product_rules.notes: Emit 1m motor rack lengths when a motor is selected.
